answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces quadratic stake burning for registering identities. A node sends a secret whisper transaction staking tokens into an ivory vault contract; upon activation, the protocol burns stake proportional to the square of active identities owned by a cluster. An attacker faces superlinear cost scaling $O(n^2)$, ensuring that deploying a flock of false identities like a raven swarm becomes economically prohibitive.
